findings.location: Paragraph beginning 'When the heart of the believer is dealt with first, the visible dimensions of the home fall into place in succession.' (English source, under heading 'The Outside Sanctified by the Word')
findings.source_quote: When the heart of the believer is dealt with first, the visible dimensions of the home fall into place in succession.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the sense of 'dealt with' as 'pris en charge', 'traité' or 'traité en premier lieu', not 'dépourvu'. Replace the current sentence with: «Quand le cœur du croyant est traité en premier lieu, les dimensions visibles du foyer se mettent en place successivement.» Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Quand le coeur du croyant est dépourvu en premier lieu, les dimensions visibles du foyer se mettent en place successivement.
